A team note from January says Marrow Fieldworks, which used to be your dealer account, changed hands on Jan 5. It doesn't say who took it over. I'm assuming it went to Tobias, so it's worth checking with him.
- **Don't mix it up with #88412.** That's a different ticket, for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse scanner.

I couldn't find a ticket file for this in the shared files, so I can't tell you the ticket's current status. Ask Tobias before your call if you need it.
